digest.headline: US equity indexes post their largest weekly gain of the year as technology shares recover.

lede.b: Wall Street shares went up this week, which means company ownership slices traded on the stock exchange increased in value. Technology firms and material producers led this climb. The S&P 500, which is an index or tracked list of five hundred big American companies, posted its biggest weekly gain of the year. Treasury yields, meaning the interest paid by the government when it borrows money from investors, also advanced alongside those rising shares. The Nasdaq index climbed 7% over Thanksgiving week as artificial intelligence stocks recovered from earlier losses.
lede.i: US equity indexes advanced alongside Treasury yields as risk appetite returned following the holiday. The S&P 500 posted its largest weekly gain of the year, driven by materials and technology shares. Meanwhile, the Nasdaq climbed 7% over Thanksgiving week as artificial intelligence stocks recovered from earlier losses. Jensen Huang returned as Nvidia CEO, bolstering market sentiment for the sector.
lede.a: The S&P 500 posted its largest weekly gain of the year as technology and materials sectors drove risk-on sentiment following the holiday. US equity indexes advanced in tandem with rising Treasury yields. The Nasdaq climbed 7% over Thanksgiving week, underpinned by an artificial intelligence recovery following leadership developments involving Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

thread.b: Global stock markets experienced gains across several regions this week. Major indices moved upward as specific sectors like technology and mining recovered. Currency values and commodity prices shifted in response to local central bank policies and trade updates.
thread.i: Global equity markets advanced across multiple regions during the trading week. Technology and mining equities provided broad support for benchmarks from London to Frankfurt and New York. Meanwhile, currency fluctuations and central bank policy commentary influenced regional asset prices.
thread.a: Equities synchronized across major jurisdictions to post significant weekly advances driven by technology and resource sectors. Central bank liquidity operations and currency depreciation channels dictated regional divergences. Commodity valuations adjusted alongside shifting geopolitical and trade inputs.

United States of America.label: United States
United States of America.sub: US markets post gains and technology shares rebound

stories.t: Wall Street Records Weekly Gains As Technology and Materials Lead
stories.b: The S&P 500 index tracks 500 of the biggest companies in America. This index just had its biggest weekly gain of the year. Materials and technology companies led the market upward. US equity indexes jumped alongside Treasury yields.
stories.i: The S&P 500 posted its largest weekly gain of the year, driven by the materials and technology sectors. US equity indexes advanced alongside Treasury yields as risk appetite returned following the holiday. Consumer discretionary shares also topped sector charts.
stories.a: The S&P 500 registered its largest weekly gain of the year, catalyzed by rotation into technology and materials. Equity indices advanced concurrently with Treasury yields, indicating a risk-on regime shift post-holidays. Consumer discretionary and tech sectors drove the breadth of the rally.

stories.t: Nasdaq Rises Seven Percent on Thanksgiving Week After Leadership Return
stories.b: The Nasdaq index tracks many technology companies. This index rose 7% during Thanksgiving week. Nvidia shares gained after Jensen Huang returned as CEO. Battered artificial intelligence stocks also climbed higher.
stories.i: The Nasdaq climbed 7% over Thanksgiving week. Artificial intelligence shares recovered from earlier losses during a volatile trading period. Jensen Huang returned as Nvidia CEO, bolstering market sentiment for the sector.
stories.a: The Nasdaq advanced 7% through Thanksgiving week as battered artificial intelligence equities staged a recovery. Jensen Huang resumed the role of Nvidia CEO, providing a fundamental catalyst for the broader tech rebound. Volatility remained elevated across tech-heavy portfolios before buyers stepped in.

United Kingdom.label: United Kingdom
United Kingdom.sub: FTSE 100 posts strongest weekly gain in eight months

stories.t: FTSE 100 registers biggest weekly gain in eight months
stories.b: The FTSE 100 is an index, which is a basket of the one hundred biggest companies listed on the London Stock Exchange. Shares in these companies represent slices of ownership in businesses. Mining companies and banks drove the index higher this week. The FTSE 100 recorded its biggest weekly gain in eight months.
stories.i: The FTSE 100 index climbed as mining shares and banks rallied across the trading session. Metal prices rebounded, supporting resource giants on the exchange. The broader market movement delivered the FTSE 100 its largest weekly gain in eight months.
stories.a: Equities pushed higher on the back of a metals rebound, driving the FTSE 100 to its strongest weekly performance in eight months. Mining heavyweights and domestic banks acted as the primary catalysts for the advance. Wall Street provided a supportive lead as global indices closed out the week in positive territory.

stories.t: Entain gains as miners lift London stocks
stories.b: Entain is a betting company whose shares trade on the stock market. Its stock gained value alongside mining firms. Miners produce metals like copper and iron. Metal prices went up, which helped miners make more money.
stories.i: Entain posted gains as a broader metals rebound boosted basic resources. Mining equities advanced on higher commodity valuations. The FTSE 100 drew additional support from Entain alongside resource heavyweights.
stories.a: Entain participated in a broader equity advance driven by commodity sector strength. Basic resource equities climbed as underlying metal prices recovered. Demand for cyclical shares cushioned the London benchmark as Wall Street staged its own rebound.

politics.b: Central banks manage money supply and interest rates for countries. The Bank of England is the central bank for the United Kingdom. Its officials showed a hawkish stance, which means they prefer higher interest rates to fight inflation.
politics.i: Bank of England officials maintained a hawkish posture on monetary policy. Their stance helped the pound rise against the US dollar. Markets weighed these domestic signals against rate hike bets from the Federal Reserve.
politics.a: Hawkish signaling from the Bank of England provided fundamental support for sterling against the greenback. The currency appreciated even as US Federal Reserve rate hike expectations shifted. This divergence in central bank pricing dictated cross-asset currency flows.

timeline: FTSE 100 records its biggest weekly gain in eight months
GBP/USD rises as Bank of England hawkishness counters Federal Reserve rate hike bets

Germany.label: Germany
Germany.sub: German stocks gain on technology and mining shares

stories.t: German Stocks Advance as Technology Shares Rebound
stories.b: An index is a basket of company shares used to track the health of a market. The DAX index tracks major German companies. The DAX index rose by 0.90% at the close of trade. Technology and mining shares drove this increase. This recovery extended gains from earlier sessions.
stories.i: The DAX index closed up 0.90%. Technology and mining shares rebounded to lift the benchmark higher. European stocks extended earlier gains during the session. Frankfurt trading reflected broader regional momentum.
stories.a: The DAX closed 0.90% higher as a broader technology and mining sector rebound extended recent gains. Equity valuations responded to sector-specific momentum across European indices. Frankfurt trading closed out the session with sustained buying pressure in growth-oriented shares.

stories.t: Bundesbank President Comments on Rate Outlook
stories.b: Central banks set the cost of borrowing money. The Bundesbank is Germany's central bank. The Bundesbank President hinted at an interest rate hike by the European Central Bank in December. Inflation is likely to stay above 3%.
stories.i: The Bundesbank President hinted at an inflation-driven December rate hike by the European Central Bank. Price growth is expected to remain above 3%. Governing Council decisions accompany ongoing monetary policy adjustments.
stories.a: The Bundesbank President signaled a potential European Central Bank rate hike for December. Persistence in inflation above the 3% threshold underpinned the hawkish remarks. Governing Council deliberations continue to focus on price stability mandates.

politics.b: European officials prepared for the selection of the next European Central Bank President. Markets tracked these leadership developments alongside stock prices. Trading in Frankfurt closed higher as investors reviewed the news.
politics.i: European authorities lined up candidates for the upcoming European Central Bank presidency. Policy leadership discussions developed parallel to equity market gains. Frankfurt indices registered gains as regional updates crossed.
politics.a: European stakeholders advanced preparations for the upcoming European Central Bank presidential succession. Governance developments ran parallel to broader equity market rallies. Macroeconomic policy expectations remained anchored to upcoming leadership transitions.

timeline: Bundesbank President discusses December rate hike expectations.
DAX index closes 0.90% higher following a technology rebound.

Japan.label: Japan
Japan.sub: Tokyo core price growth hits 16-month high amid weak yen

stories.t: Tokyo Core Price Growth Accelerates
stories.b: Tokyo core inflation reached a 16-month high. Price growth measures how much more everyday things cost over time. The Japanese yen stayed weak against other currencies. This currency drop makes imported food and energy much pricier for local households. Tokyo core inflation reached a 16-month high for households.
stories.i: Tokyo core inflation touched a 16-month high. Persistent currency weakness in the Japanese yen drove up import costs for local households. The depreciation of the Japanese currency directly transmits higher expenses into domestic consumer prices. Tokyo core inflation reached a 16-month high for households.
stories.a: Tokyo core inflation printed at a 16-month high. Continued weakness in the Japanese yen served as the primary transmission mechanism for imported price pressures. FX pass-through effects compressed household purchasing power across the capital. Tokyo core inflation reached a 16-month high for households.

stories.t: Japanese Equities and Currency Flows
stories.b: The Nikkei index extended its weekly gain. Investors bought shares in artificial intelligence companies that had dropped in price before. The Japanese yen slipped against the US dollar. Calmer equity markets helped push up US Treasury yields.
stories.i: The Nikkei index extended its weekly gain as investors bought battered artificial intelligence shares. The Japanese yen slipped against the US dollar. Calmer equity markets helped lift US Treasury yields, reducing demand for safe-haven currency positions.
stories.a: The Nikkei index extended its weekly advance driven by dip-buying in artificial intelligence equities. The Japanese yen slipped against the US dollar as calmer equity markets lifted US Treasury yields. Higher sovereign yields widened interest rate differentials against Japanese assets.

politics.b: Local leaders faced growing backlash over data center subsidies. Officials weighed the local impact of these large technology hubs on communities. Residents voiced concerns about electricity and space use.
politics.i: Local authorities faced a growing backlash over data center subsidies. Municipal officials assessed the local environmental and resource impact of facility developments. Community pushback intensified around state-backed technology infrastructure.
politics.a: Municipal authorities confronted a growing backlash over data center subsidies. Local governments weighed the regional resource footprint against economic incentives. Community resistance challenged central planning targets for digital infrastructure.

China.label: China
China.sub: Corporate earnings, trade data, and local industry rounds

stories.t: Meituan reports profit return
stories.b: Meituan is a big company that delivers food. It made a profit again. This happened because companies stopped spending so much money on discounts to win customers.
stories.i: Meituan posted a return to profit. Food delivery subsidy competition eased across the sector. Margin pressure subsided as customer acquisition costs fell.
stories.a: Meituan returned to profitability. The alleviation of food delivery subsidy competition drove the margin expansion. Unit economics improved as promotional cash burn abated.

stories.t: Xiaxian secures early funding
stories.b: A company named Xiaxian raised tens of millions of yuan. It did this across three early rounds of funding. People invest money into young companies to help them grow.
stories.i: Xiaxian raised tens of millions of yuan. The capital came across three early funding rounds. Early-stage venture capital continues to flow into the firm.
stories.a: Xiaxian secured tens of millions of yuan. Three consecutive early rounds closed to aggregate this capital. Seed and early-stage valuation metrics remain active for the entity.

stories.t: Ice and snow sector targets milestone
stories.b: China's ice and snow equipment industry is growing. It is set to pass 100 billion yuan in the year 2026. This industry makes gear for cold weather sports.
stories.i: China's ice and snow equipment industry expects to surpass 100 billion yuan in 2026. Manufacturing output for winter sports gear scales up. Domestic demand supports this sector expansion.
stories.a: China's ice and snow equipment industry targets a valuation exceeding 100 billion yuan in 2026. Industrial output scales to meet winter sports demand. Capital expenditure follows supportive state directives for cold-weather infrastructure.

India.label: India
India.sub: RBI tightens rules on money mules and conducts repo auction

stories.t: RBI Introduces Rules to Target Money Mule Accounts
stories.src: Reserve Bank of India · Business Standard
stories.b: The Reserve Bank of India issued final rules allowing banks to put temporary debit freezes on accounts suspected of financial fraud. Banks can now act quickly on accounts linked to illegal money movement. The central bank originally published a draft version of these guidelines for public feedback on September 11, 2026. This system uses a standard procedure to stop fraudulent transactions. The order was officially released on November 27, 2026.
stories.i: The Reserve Bank of India finalized amendment directions allowing banks to place temporary debit holds on accounts suspected of financial fraud. Lenders can now utilize a standardized operating procedure to freeze suspicious balances. The central bank previously issued draft proposals for stakeholder feedback on September 11, 2026. These measures aim to curb cyber-enabled financial crimes and illicit carry structures.
stories.a: The Reserve Bank of India promulgated final Know Your Customer amendment directions establishing uniform protocols for banks to impose suo moto temporary debit holds on accounts flagged for financial fraud. The framework codifies a time-bound operational procedure first published as a draft on September 11, 2026. These administrative controls alter counterparty risk parameters within domestic payment channels by shifting liability thresholds for suspicious fund flows.

stories.t: Central Bank Announces Variable Rate Repo Auction
stories.b: The Reserve Bank of India will hold an overnight Variable Rate Repo auction on November 30, 2026. The central bank manages money supply by lending cash to banks through this tool. The auction offers a notified amount of ₹50,000 crore for a tenor of 1 day. Banks can bid during the morning window between 09:30 AM and 10:00 AM. The funds will be reversed on December 1, 2026.
stories.i: The Reserve Bank of India scheduled an overnight Variable Rate Repo auction under the liquidity adjustment facility for November 30, 2026. The central bank will inject ₹50,000 crore into the banking system for a 1-day tenor. Bidding takes place between 09:30 AM and 10:00 AM. The reversal of these funds is set for December 1, 2026, following a review of near-term liquidity conditions.
stories.a: The Reserve Bank of India instituted an overnight Variable Rate Repo auction under the liquidity adjustment facility, scheduling the operation for November 30, 2026. The liquidity injection targets ₹50,000 crore across a single-day tenor to address evolving short-term funding pressures. Counterparties access the window during a 30-minute bidding period ending at 10:00 AM, with the reversal scheduled for December 1, 2026.

politics.b: The Reserve Bank deputy governor Shri Swaminathan J chaired the 31st meeting of the Standing Advisory Committee in Kolkata on November 27, 2026. Officials from the Ministry of MSME and the Department of Financial Services attended the gathering. They reviewed the flow of credit to micro, small and medium enterprises. Data shows state government loans and advances stood at ₹19,965 crore as of November 20, 2026.
politics.i: Reserve Bank of India Deputy Governor Shri Swaminathan J chaired the 31st Standing Advisory Committee meeting in Kolkata on November 27, 2026. Officials from the Ministry of MSME and the Department of Financial Services reviewed credit flows to micro, small and medium enterprises. Concurrently, provisional weekly statistical data showed state government loans and advances at ₹19,965 crore on November 20, 2026. Foreign exchange reserves and other central bank balance sheet figures were also updated.
politics.a: Deputy Governor Shri Swaminathan J presided over the 31st meeting of the Standing Advisory Committee on MSME credit flows in Kolkata on November 27, 2026, alongside representatives from the Ministry of MSME and the Department of Financial Services. Provisional statistical data released by the central bank recorded state government loans and advances at ₹19,965 crore as of November 20, 2026. These administrative reviews coincide with ongoing Treasury bill auctions totaling ₹23,000 crore announced for December 2026 settlement.

timeline: Reserve Bank of India issued draft KYC amendment directions on money mule accounts.
State government loans and advances reached ₹19,965 crore according to RBI data.

Brazil.label: Brazil
Brazil.sub: Brazil markets surge on currency and leadership news

stories.t: Brazilian Real and Stock Market Jump
stories.b: The Brazilian real gained 4.8% following a decision by President Lula. Brazil's Ibovespa stock index surged 6.4%. This stock jump happened after the appointment of the Bradesco chairman. Currency strength also pushed up prices for sugar and coffee.
stories.i: The Brazilian real climbed 4.8% after a policy move by Lula. The Ibovespa index rallied 6.4% following the naming of the Bradesco chairman. Stronger currency values simultaneously supported higher prices in agricultural commodities like sugar and coffee.
stories.a: Lula's recent decision catalyzed a 4.8% appreciation in the real, while the Ibovespa surged 6.4% on the appointment of the Bradesco chairman. This currency transmission channel immediately boosted dollar-denominated soft commodities, lifting both sugar and coffee futures.

stories.t: Petrobras Rigs Idled and Platforms Extended
stories.b: Two idled Petrobras rigs in Guanabara Bay turned a $20.4 million profit for Ventura Offshore into a $12.6 million loss. Petrobras kept its Sergipe platforms operational until 2030 and 2031. The gas route for those platforms remains under review.
stories.i: Ventura Offshore swung from a $20.4 million profit to a $12.6 million loss after two Petrobras rigs stopped working in Guanabara Bay. Meanwhile, Petrobras extended the operational life of its Sergipe platforms to 2030 and 2031. The associated gas transport route stays under review.
stories.a: Idling two Petrobras rigs in Guanabara Bay drove Ventura Offshore from a $20.4 million profit into a $12.6 million loss. Simultaneously, Petrobras scheduled its Sergipe platforms to remain operational through 2030 and 2031 while keeping the gas evacuation infrastructure under review.

politics.b: President Lula made a decision that caused the Brazilian real to climb in value.
politics.i: President Lula enacted a decision that triggered a sharp rally in the Brazilian real.
politics.a: President Lula's recent policy decision served as the primary catalyst for the currency movement.

timeline: Two Petrobras rigs idled in Guanabara Bay
Petrobras keeps Sergipe platforms operational until 2030 and 2031

Saudi Arabia.label: Saudi Arabia
Saudi Arabia.sub: Oil markets react to refinery attacks and OPEC pressure

stories.t: Refinery Attack and Production Disputes
stories.b: A deadly strike hit a Saudi Aramco oil refinery in Jizan. Oil prices rose after this attack on the tanker and refinery. Iraq asked OPEC for a higher production quota ahead of upcoming talks. Crude prices erased their early gains as this push for higher output became clear.
stories.i: A Houthi strike hit Saudi Aramco's Jizan refinery, driving an initial jump in oil prices. Iraq lobbied OPEC for a higher production quota ahead of the OPEC+ output talks for the first quarter of 2027. Crude prices subsequently erased their early gains as this output pressure weighed on the market.
stories.a: A lethal strike targeted Saudi Aramco's Jizan refinery, prompting a transient spike in crude benchmarks. Concurrently, Iraq pressed OPEC for an elevated production quota ahead of the upcoming OPEC+ ministerial meetings. Crude prices surrendered their intraday gains as market participants digested the supply implications of Iraq's quota demands.

stories.t: Diplomatic Friction Surrounds OPEC Membership
stories.b: The United States pushed Iraq and Venezuela to leave OPEC. This US lobbying sparked a Saudi intervention in the matter. Novak stated he had not heard that Iraq and Venezuela could quit the group.
stories.i: United States lobbying urged Iraq and Venezuela to exit OPEC, triggering a diplomatic intervention by Saudi Arabia. Russian official Novak stated that he had not heard reports of Iraq and Venezuela potentially quitting the organization.
stories.a: Washington lobbied Baghdad and Caracas to exit OPEC, inciting a defensive diplomatic intervention from Riyadh. Russian Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak noted no official awareness of any impending withdrawal by Iraq or Venezuela from the cartel.

politics.b: Saudi Arabia intervened after the United States lobbied other oil nations. Iraq pushed for higher output quotas ahead of upcoming meetings.
politics.i: Saudi Arabia stepped in diplomatically following US lobbying efforts directed at OPEC members. Meanwhile, Iraq engaged in bilateral talks for higher quotas ahead of OPEC+ decisions.
politics.a: Riyadh executed a diplomatic intervention in response to external lobbying of cartel members by Washington. Concurrently, Baghdad pursued formal quota revisions ahead of scheduled OPEC+ output deliberations.

timeline: Reports detail US lobbying of Iraq and Venezuela to exit OPEC.
A Houthi strike hits Saudi Aramco's Jizan refinery.
Iraq pushes for higher quotas ahead of OPEC+ output talks.

Nigeria.label: Nigeria
Nigeria.sub: Naira gains against the dollar and inflation data updates

stories.t: Naira records appreciation against the dollar in official markets
stories.src: Daily Post Nigeria · Business News Nigeria · Legit.ng
stories.b: The Nigerian currency, called the naira, went up in value against the dollar. This means one dollar costs fewer naira than before. The official market saw the naira gain 19 naira in value. Bureau de change dollar supply tested the market. The naira recorded its biggest daily appreciation against the dollar.
stories.i: The naira strengthened against the dollar in official trading sessions. The central bank released a new dollar price as the local currency gained 19 naira. Bureau de change dollar supply tested market conditions. The naira also posted smaller gains of 4.36 naira officially.
stories.a: The official market recorded a significant appreciation of the naira against the dollar. The central bank published a new dollar price alongside the currency's gain of 19 naira. Bureau de change dollar supply dynamics exerted downward pressure on the exchange rate. The naira also printed a secondary gain of 4.36 naira in official segments.

stories.t: Inflation rate trends and food price figures in Nigeria
stories.b: Overall inflation in Nigeria is falling according to reports. However, food inflation has doubled since the month of January. This means the cost of eating went up a lot even as the general rate slowed. The data was reported on November 27, 2026.
stories.i: Headline inflation showed a downward trajectory in the latest data releases. Conversely, food inflation doubled compared to the figures recorded in January. The divergence highlights stark differences between general price measures and staple food costs. The reports emerged on November 27, 2026.
stories.a: Headline inflation prints indicated a declining trajectory. Simultaneously, food inflation registered a doubling relative to its January baseline. This dispersion complicates the macro read on household purchasing power. The statistics were circulated on November 27, 2026.

politics.b: A police investigator told a court that former central bank boss Godwin Emefiele changed banknotes without presidential approval. The investigator stated that former President Buhari approved a naira redesign, not a simple colour swap. Police commissioners also stated that the redesign differed from what was approved.
politics.i: Court testimony from a police investigator alleged that former central bank governor Godwin Emefiele altered banknotes without presidential backing. The witness clarified that former President Buhari approved a redesign rather than a standard colour swap. A police commissioner previously stated that the executed redesign diverged from the official presidential approval.
politics.a: Judicial proceedings featured testimony from a police investigator alleging unauthorized banknote modifications by former central bank chief Godwin Emefiele. The testimony specified that former President Buhari authorized a structural redesign rather than a superficial colour swap. A police commissioner corroborated that the implemented currency changes deviated from the presidential directive.

timeline: Naira records daily appreciation against the dollar in official markets

Australia.label: Australia
Australia.sub: Australian Dollar faces pressure as US rate bets stall recovery

stories.t: Australian Dollar Recovery Stalls Against US Dollar
stories.b: The Australian Dollar stopped growing in value compared to the US Dollar. Traders expect the US central bank, which sets borrowing costs, to raise interest rates soon. This makes the US Dollar more attractive and limits the Australian currency's bounce. Rabobank analysts expect the Australian Dollar to experience further losses.
stories.i: The Australian Dollar recovery stalled against the US Dollar as Federal Reserve rate hike bets capped the pair. Rabobank analysts noted that further losses against the US currency remain likely. Higher yield expectations in the US continue to exert downward pressure on the antipodean currency.
stories.a: Federal Reserve monetary tightening expectations constrained the AUD/USD pair, terminating the recent recovery attempt. Rabobank strategists project extended downside momentum for the Australian tender as cross-border yield differentials widen. The market is pricing in a more hawkish Fed trajectory, rendering the carry trade dynamics unfavorable for long Australian Dollar positions.

stories.t: Fortescue Shares Face Iron Ore Pressure from China
stories.b: Fortescue shares might be undervalued after experiencing pressure from iron ore pricing in China. Simply Wall St reported on the situation affecting the ASX-listed mining company. Iron ore is a key commodity for Australian exports.
stories.i: Fortescue shares traded under pressure following iron ore developments originating from China. Simply Wall St analyzed the ASX-listed miner's valuation in light of these commodity headwinds. Lower iron ore price realizations typically compress margins for major Australian producers.
stories.a: Fortescue equity valuations reflect compressed multiples following sustained iron ore price pressures driven by Chinese demand dynamics. Simply Wall St evaluated the ASX-listed producer's intrinsic value amidst deteriorating spot benchmarks. The transmission channel directly impacts operating cash flows for pure-play iron ore exporters.
